channel.title: Cabo Verde - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cabo Verde, every source cited.

item.title: Praia mayor seeks special status for capital city
item.description: Fernando Pinto argues for differentiated treatment of Praia due to the costs of its capital status.

item.title: Cape Verde to install five mammography machines by 2027
item.description: The government plans to increase diagnostic capacity for stomach cancer and other diseases.

item.title: Cape Verde radiation levels within safe limits
item.description: ARME reports non-ionizing radiation from radiofrequency stations in Praia poses no public health danger.

item.title: Banco BAI Cabo Verde launches mobile bank branch
item.description: The first mobile banking unit in Cape Verde will bring services to different locations.

item.title: Cape Verde hosts weekend of music and arts
item.description: Events include magazine launch, concerts, and a festival in Praia and São Domingos.
